mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in employment levels (PAYEMS) above 143,000 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as it signals labor market expansion and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite PAYEMS crossing the threshold, or p-value > 0.05 in a 3-month t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) proxies indicates a robust demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (e.g., sustained FEDFUNDS increases), S&P 500 forward returns become positively correlated with the tightening signal over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month's value for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive during periods meeting the trigger condition, or p-value > 0.05 over any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the INDPRO index signals expanding supply conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it reflects broader economic resilience.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) crosses above 5.5%, it triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as it signals labor market strengthening and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or p-value > 0.05 in a 3-month t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the INDPRO index indicates expanding supply conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects economic stability.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC < 0.1 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) proxies signals a robust demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 18-month window.
